why-i-dont-send-welcome-sequences-anymor.quickAnswer: Why I stopped sending a traditional welcome sequence, and what I send instead: one Start Here email. In this solo episode I explain why welcome sequences started to feel off for my audience, what is changing in the inbox heading into 2026, and why the delivery email is usually the most-opened email you will ever send. Then I walk through what goes into a Start Here email (a human introduction, clear expectations, a few places to explore and an invitation to reply) so new subscribers feel welcomed instead of marched through a funnel. You can grab the free Start Here email template and run it as a 30-day test.
